integrity: The proof first classifies all minimum vertex covers of the half graph as staircase complements of its maximum independent sets. Interior minimum covers require two defenders, forced by the two leaves b_1 and a_n; endpoint equality requires one additional positive universal vertex and one forced defender. This yields the exact n+2 minimum and every optimizer.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies minimum functions rather than all feasible outer-independent total Roman functions.
The case n=2 has one exceptional all-one minimum.
Finite exhaustive verification through n=7 is corroborative only.
A differently phrased or non-indexed half-graph treatment may exist.
title: Minimum outer-independent total Roman functions of half graphs
